A man who fatally shot a teen searching for his phone in a gated Florida community will not be criminally charged, according to authorities.

The shooter, who is in his mid-20s, fatally gunned down the high-school freshman — identified by family as 15-year-old Heitor Amaral — in a Tampa apartment complex Sept. 20, said the Tampa Police Department and Tampa Bay Times.

Investigators have concluded that they will not be able to charge the unidentified gun-wielding resident based on a “comprehensive review of the evidence,” police announced Thursday.

Heitor lost his cellphone and teamed up with two of his friends later that day to locate it — using tracking-technology pings to trace it to the complex on River Willow Place, cops said.
